title: Sparkly anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='metal' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8c6e0'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#8ea3c8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6b80a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='metal2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d0dcef'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7f93b8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='8' fill='none' stroke='url(#metal)' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='15' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#e6eefb' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- vertical shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='48' rx='3' fill='url(#metal2)'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='24' width='2' height='44' rx='1' fill='#eef4ff'/>

  <!-- ring halo detail on shank top -->
  <rect x='43' y='26' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a8bad8'/>

  <!-- stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x='30' y='36' width='40' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='url(#metal)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='36' width='40' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#dbe6f6'/>

  <!-- arms (curved flukes) -->
  <path d='M46 66 C 36 68, 24 66, 18 56 C 14 49, 16 42, 22 40 C 26 38.5, 30 41, 31 46'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#metal)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 66 C 64 68, 76 66, 82 56 C 86 49, 84 42, 78 40 C 74 38.5, 70 41, 69 46'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#metal)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 66 C 36 68, 24 66, 18 56' fill='none' stroke='#dfe9f8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 66 C 64 68, 76 66, 82 56' fill='none' stroke='#dfe9f8' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- fluke tips -->
  <path d='M18 56 L 14 52 L 21 50 Z' fill='#9fb2d2'/>
  <path d='M82 56 L 86 52 L 79 50 Z' fill='#9fb2d2'/>

  <!-- bottom point -->
  <path d='M50 70 L 56 78 L 50 90 L 44 78 Z' fill='url(#metal2)'/>
  <path d='M50 72 L 50 86' stroke='#eef4ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe98a'>
    <path d='M20 20 L 23 26 L 20 32 L 17 26 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 22 L 84.5 27 L 82 32 L 79.5 27 Z'/>
    <path d='M78 82 L 80.5 87 L 78 92 L 75.5 87 Z'/>
    <path d='M24 80 L 26 84.5 L 24 89 L 22 84.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M62 12 L 63.5 15 L 65 18 L 63.5 21 L 62 18 L 60.5 15 Z'/>
    <path d='M38 12 L 39.5 15 L 41 18 L 39.5 21 L 38 18 L 36.5 15 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#fffbe0'>
    <circle cx='20' cy='24' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='27' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='86' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='84' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='16' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='16' r='1.1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
